structures.description: Rev. Joseph Sherfy, about 50 acres; brick house (1840s); original barn, hospital, "riddled" with shot; orchard (114 trees survived the battle)

structures.state_and_damage_printed: House: south and west walls scarred, 7+ shell hits, roof punctured. Barn burned: timing conflict.
